newsitem.title: USA: Illinois nuke to stay shut into maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Illinois nuke to stay shut into maintenance.

text.p: Illinois Power Co said its 930 megawatt Clinton nuclear power plant in Clinton, Ill., will not resume operations prior to a scheduled maintenance outage set for Oct 13.
"We will not resume operations prior to our expected shutdown on (Oct) 13," company spokesman John Dewey said Friday.
The unit was shut Sept 6 for repairs to a recirculation pump seal. The outage was extended while Illinois Power addressed some operational concerns voiced by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC).
NRC concerns were the reason for the latest extension of the plant shutdown also, Dewey said.
"There was an NRC meeting at Clinton today (Friday), they listed a number of apparent violations of procedures at the plant," the spokesman said.
"We are taking aggressive action to address those apparent violations."
The plant was scheduled to be shut down for refueling and maintenance for 43 days beginning October 13.
Illinois Power is a subsidiary of Illinova Corp.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
